independent_claim_checks.claim: Gallagher Expands Texas Employee Benefits Operations via Mund Group Deal
independent_claim_checks.source_excerpt: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co., an international insurance brokerage and risk management firm, has announced its acquisition of Mund Group, Ltd., a Texas-based agency specialising in employee benefits, with the financial details of the deal not disclosed. Headquartered in New Braunfels, Mund Group advises businesses on employee benefits and provides consulting services covering health and welfare programmes.
